Subject: A faded old wall mural in a dim stone hall: a young prince in a gold circlet raising a sword before a horde of crude pit creatures (small goblins and bony shapes) crawling out of a black pit. Painted like an old church mural with cracks and flaking paint; the prince heroic and tall, the creatures small and many. Dim torchlight on the wall

An evening square in a small medieval town, lanterns lit. Close view of a young woman in a simple dress and a mercenary captain seen from behind (his face not visible, broad shoulders, worn leather coat). His hands pin a small white lily brooch on her dress. Her face quiet, serious and tender. Behind them, a white lily banner on a pole

A dim throne room. A king in gold robes on a high throne, his face half in shadow. His hand points down at a band of kneeling mercenaries as he gives an order, but his head is turned and his eyes are fixed on a young woman standing at the side behind them; everyone looks at the king, the king looks only at her. She is the young woman of the second image: curly brown hair tied up, a simple dress with a small white lily brooch, her face seen in three-quarter view, worried, looking at the mercenaries and not at the king. The mercenaries are seen from behind, a white lily banner among them

Night at the edge of a huge black pit in a dead forest, torches. Soldiers in plain iron helmets turn against the mercenaries beside them; under the helmets their faces have become monstrous: ash-grey skin, flat pale sickly green eyes without pupils, crooked teeth. Mercenaries under a white lily banner caught by surprise. The chaos is shown by silhouettes

Looking up from the dark bottom of a black pit: steep earthen walls, the rim far above against the night sky, one torch at the rim and the small dark silhouette of a crowned king looking down. Pale sickly green glints of eyes in the dark around the bottom. The viewer lies at the bottom of the pit

A crowded courtroom hall in grey daylight from high windows. A chained man kneels before a judge's bench, seen from behind, his right sleeve ending in a bandaged stump. In the crowd, one young woman's face in grief, a small white lily brooch on her dress

A prison cell wall covered from floor to ceiling with thousands of scratched tally marks in rows. Through a crack low in the stone, an old knight's bony hand reaches in. Faint grey light from a tiny barred window. No person in full view
Night. A burial sack falling from the top of a tall prison wall on a cliff into a black river far below. Moonlight on the water, the dark prison tower above

The bottom of a dry stone well under a ruined hunting lodge, moonlight falling in a pale shaft from the round opening far above. A man kneels at an old iron-bound strongbox full of gold coins, seen from his left side and a little behind, his face turned away and not visible. He lifts the lid with his LEFT hand; his right forearm ends in a short stump wrapped in a white bandage, exactly as on the man of the second image; he has no right hand, and he holds that arm against his body. On the lid, a worn old royal crest of a crowned stag

A slave market in a muddy town square under a grey sky. A young woman of about twenty in chains stands on a low wooden block, an iron collar around her neck, in a plain ragged grey shift: a black bob with thick blunt bangs, large dark eyes, a small beauty mark just below her left eye, a sharp, cold, clever face: the young woman of the second image, with clean bare hands. In the foreground, a left hand in a dark glove offers gold coins; the buyer is only a dark shoulder seen from behind

An open old ledger on a wooden table, its pages filled with rows of small scribbled marks. A man in a dark fur-collared coat sits at the table seen from behind, his face not visible: his LEFT hand rests on the page; his right forearm ends in a short stump wrapped in a white bandage, exactly as on the man of the second image; he has no right hand, and that arm rests on the table beside the ledger. Through the window behind it, the sun in a pale sky with a black bite taken out of one edge, as if bitten by a beast

The edge of a dead forest at dusk, a black pit far in the distance. A man in a worn leather coat seen strictly from behind, his head and face turned away and never visible, standing still at a distance from the pit. His right arm hangs at his side: his right forearm ends in a short stump wrapped in a white bandage, exactly as on the man of the second image; he has no right hand. A black stain like spilled ink spreads from the bandaged end up the forearm toward the elbow

A palace balcony at dusk, seen from a little below and close enough to read her face. A queen of nearly forty stands alone at the railing, looking far away with a quiet, sad face: curly brown hair tied up and streaked with a few grey strands, a plain grey gown, and a small white lily brooch clearly visible on her chest. She is the young woman of the second image, twenty years older. Banners with a golden sun crest hang from the palace

A small village at night. A hooded figure seen from behind raises a banner with a black-painted lily on a pole. Under a lantern, mercenaries of different kinds (a big warrior with an axe, an archer, a hooded mage) step down from a stagecoach
